segments.text: Come! Let’s return to Yahweh; for he has torn us to pieces, and he will heal us; he has injured us, and he will bind up our wounds.
segments.speaker: Israel

segments.text:
After two days he will revive us. On the third day he will raise us up, 
and we will live before him.
segments.speaker: Israel

segments.text: Let’s acknowledge Yahweh. Let’s press on to know Yahweh. As surely as the sun rises, Yahweh will appear. He will come to us like the rain, like the spring rain that waters the earth.
segments.speaker: Israel

segments.text: “Ephraim, what shall I do to you? Judah, what shall I do to you?
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text:
For your love is like a morning cloud,
and like the dew that disappears early.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Therefore I have cut them to pieces with the prophets; I killed them with the words of my mouth.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Your judgments are like a flash of lightning.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: For I desire mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: But they, like Adam, have broken the covenant. They were unfaithful to me there.
Gilead is a city of those who work iniquity; it is stained with blood.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: As gangs of robbers wait to ambush a man, so the company of priests murder on the path toward Shechem,
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: In the house of Israel I have seen a horrible thing. There is prostitution in Ephraim.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: “Also, Judah, there is a harvest appointed for you, when I restore the fortunes of my people.
segments.speaker: The LORD
